meta.batch: ARCHITECTURE BATCH 1 — Core Hub Architecture Release
meta.site: รับซื้อไอทีโคราช.com
meta.policy: Strengthen deterministic parent→child, child→parent and bounded sibling links. Batch 5 additionally releases /พื้นที่ as the real local authority hub.
meta.expansionPolicy: W1 adds 24 Brand + 16 Series live routes; remaining INDEX350 candidates stay HOLD and are not emitted.
meta.guideAuthorityPolicy: The live /บทความ hub remains the URL parent; virtual topical guide clusters are non-linkable organizational nodes.
meta.navigationPolicy: Header/Footer use bounded hub-first global discovery; contextual child/sibling discovery remains delegated to runtime architecture.
meta.seoIndexPolicy: Sitemap/canonical/robots/BreadcrumbList/WebPage/ItemList ownership is registry-driven. Native business/article/FAQ schema requires source review.
meta.architectureQualityGatePolicy: Expansion remains locked until static architecture validation passes and real-repository build/crawl integration is attested.
meta.expansionRound1Policy: ASUS/ROG and Dell/Latitude only; no model release.
